messages:
lia: Opening a refresh PR for the onboarding quickstart (hello-starter). Focus: streamline auth, consolidate Node/Python to SDK v6, and shorten the first-deploy checklist. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1309

samir: sweet. quick request: the previous guide told users to `export TOKEN=...`. we should recommend `REDWOOD_API_KEY` for hosted examples and keep a note for `REDWOOD_TOKEN` in "private installs". can you add that callout?

lia: yep — plan is to show both but mark `REDWOOD_API_KEY` as recommended for hosted users. also adding a short section on where to store keys in CI (GH Actions / GitLab).

cameron: saw the Docker section — much cleaner now. one thing: can we include a tiny migration snippet for folks on older SDKs showing `RedwoodClient` -> `Redwood` and the new streaming pattern? people still search for that.

jordan: small FYI: found a broken link in the current live quickstart to the token FAQ. repo path changed from docs/token-mgmt.md -> docs/auth/tokens.md. PR should update that.

docs-bot: PR #1309 preview available: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/hello-starter (checks: lint, link-checker, snippet-runner) :white_check_mark:

lia: pushing a commit to fix the token link and add a migration note. also swapping the env example to: 

```bash
# hosted (recommended)
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk-live-..."

# private/dedicated (legacy support)
export REDWOOD_TOKEN="rt-onprem-..."
```

samir: linter flagged a phrasing nit — we say "private installs" in one place and "private/dedicated" in another. prefer consistent term `Private/Dedicated`. I can push a tiny wording patch.

devex-bot: lint: 3 warnings (terminology consistency), 1 error (node snippet missing import). See pipeline.

cameron: snippet-runner failed: 
```
ERROR: snip-runner hello-starter/node/example.md:12 - ReferenceError: Redwood is not defined
```

lia: argh, I removed the import while refactoring. fixing now to include `const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference')` in Node example and the `from redwood.inference import Redwood` line in Python.

jordan: for review assignment: @cameron will take deploy checklist/edit, @samir will finalize auth wording, @lia will fix snippets and merge when green. lmk if you can't.

cameron: I can take the checklist and run a local Docker smoke test this afternoon. will report back with any tweaks.

samir: I'll re-review the auth section in ~90 minutes. focusing on CI secrets guidance and the example env var names.

docs-bot: CI update: link-checker passed, snippet-runner initially failed, re-run in progress.

gh-actions: PR #1309 - snippet fix pushed by lia (commit 0a1b2c3). running checks...

devex-bot: warning: codeblock language mismatch in hello-starter/python/example.md. Please add `python` after the triple backticks.

lia: fixed import + language tags, pushed. also added a brief note about redwood CLI vs SDK usage for first deploy.

docs-bot: all checks passed for PR #1309 :white_check_mark:

gh-actions: merged PR #1309 into main by lia — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abc123def :tada:

lia: thanks everyone! I'll add a short changelog entry and drop a note in #all-hands-docs. cc: product for visibility. :sparkles:

cameron: nice cleanup. follow-ups: we still need a short migration HOWTO for SDK v4 -> v6 in the upgrade guide. @samir can you own that next sprint?

samir: yep I'll draft that as a small doc and link it from the quickstart.

lia: closing thread. will open a follow-up for the upgrade HOWTO once samir posts a rough draft.
